reproducibility_follow_up.fix: Optional generated addon.inf mtime parameter in core create_addon; offline addon builder explicitly uses zero and rejects older core exporters without this capability. Existing callers retain current-time behavior.
reproducibility_follow_up.verification: Both matching first-build TARs passed Extended identity and hash preflight. A legacy builder invoking create_addon without the new argument generated addon.inf with current time; the modified offline builder used timestamp zero.
reproducibility_follow_up.automated_tests: Six addon policy/reproducibility tests passed. Full hub discovery on a temporary expected-layout checkout: 68 tests, 67 passed, one skipped because local PHP lacked cURL. An initial run against the wrong directory layout failed to locate the CMS files and was rerun with the proper layout.
limits: Reproducibility is verified for repeated builds from the same working tree and filesystem metadata, not across machines or checkouts.
No web installation, signature, publication, or final package acceptance.
